The tests pass: all 3 of 3 in `npm test`, including the previously failing 15% discount test.

The discount in `src/cart.js` was rounded down with `Math.floor`. I changed it to `Math.round`, so 157.5 now rounds to 158 and the total comes out at 892. I didn't touch `lineTotal`, the no-discount path, the test file, or the dependencies.

`Math.round` rounds exact halves up, which is what the test asks for. A discount can't be negative, so the way `Math.round` treats negative halves doesn't matter here.

I haven't committed anything.
